independent_local_arithmetic: PowerShell recomputed all three ratios, sample standard deviation, 12-row denominator, per-program steps and hashes from transferred receipts; not a second execution or scorer.
descriptive_identity: pipeline_time - share_time = summed_candidate_duration_difference + overlap_difference + outside_candidate_difference. This accounting identity does not identify causal components.
interpretation: Frozen exploratory gate passes: complete 12/12, identical 150/588 steps and all six outputs per source byte-identical. Strong chronological CNN runtime drift limits attribution of the 1.2484 median to overlap. The reverse-order middle pair has nearly equal summed candidate time and ratio 1.1602, but it is one descriptive pair, not a separately selected confirmation.

phase_evidence.independent_recomputation: PowerShell explicit-double interval arithmetic agrees with Python and all six original primary candidate overlaps. Four local and remote synthetic tests passed.
phase_evidence.verification_corrections: Initial PowerShell check used the wrong property-collection count and then inferred integer Math.Max from literal 0. Both refused before success. Explicit collection enumeration and double arguments fixed the checking commands, not any original experimental or Python result.
phase_evidence.interpretation: Consistent with phase complementarity, not evidence requiring simultaneous GPU training. First optimizer is after forward/backward and can follow earlier CUDA activity; host envelopes and sparse NVML cannot prove absence of all concurrent kernels. The pipeline reference parallelizes initialization but serializes entire candidate bodies; it is not a first-CUDA-admission or general phase-aware baseline.

boundaries: Two new source variants in the same two task/program families, not independent new tasks.
Original-seed restarts, not independent training seeds.
Fixed-query output invariance, not task-quality improvement or simultaneous GPU-kernel evidence.
No own heavy preparation overlapped measurement; whole-host co-tenancy and the cause of drift were not isolated.
Do not replace the frozen all-three-pair result with the middle pair or declare the drift corrected.
The later reverse-order batch did not produce paired timings; chronological confounding remains unresolved.
